title: Vitess: re-join a removed tablet to its shard
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add vitess --role replica --shard 80-`: finds a provisioned-but-stopped tablet in the shard, restarts mysqlctld+vttablet, waits for it to re-register in the topo as a REPLICA.

observe.what: vitess-shard2-tablet-3 re-joined shard 80- as a REPLICA in ~8s (vttablet re-registered; mysqld resumes replication)

whatProves: VitessAdapter.ScaleOutAddAsync brings a stopped tablet of the target shard back up so vttablet re-registers it in the topo (apply-on-demand for genuine growth, ADR-0010).
